items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin comfortable while it adjusts to a retinol.
A lower-strength retinol is a sensible starting point for softening the look of lines and uneven texture.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream helps with the low moisture reading and supports a smoother, plumper look.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside retinol and helps protect against further visible signs of aging.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, moisturizer, then SPF 50. Evenings: cleanse, retinol on 2 nights a week at first, then moisturizer, building up slowly if skin stays comfortable.
